claim_boundary: This pre-registers a fresh local router test. It generates no model output and does not access benchmark, canary, holdout, or training rows. Passing authorizes only a separately pre-registered question-only router scan.

decision_policy.failed: Publish negative evidence and stop this router. Do not tune or rerun on the observed local surface.
decision_policy.passed: Publish local evidence and separately pre-register a question-only real-surface router scan. Do not generate benchmark outputs.
